description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractErrorResponseAdapter' which provides mechanisms for mapping error responses to and from adaptability objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles parsing error JSON, constructing error responses, and managing headers and topic paths related to error responses.

classes.name: AbstractErrorResponseAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class providing mechanisms to convert error responses to and from an adaptable format, handling JSON parsing, header translation, and topic path construction based on error responses.

methods.name: parseWithErrorRegistry
methods.description: Parses a JSON error object using an error registry; falls back to creating an unknown error exception if parsing fails.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an adaptable object into an error response by extracting headers, topic path, and JSON payload, parsing the error.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Creates an adaptable object from an error response, including constructing payload, headers, and topic path.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to provide a topic path builder for a specific error response.

methods.name: buildErrorResponse
methods.description: Abstract method to build an error response object from topic path, exception, and headers.
